Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

We got some new neighbors recently, and this week I went around and said hi to the new Syrian family and the other new French family. I only met the dad in each family and they both seemed so nice and caring. But then later that night I saw the dad from the Syrian family, who had seemed so nice before, slap his wife during an argument. At least I still know the French one is a good guy, he was cooking dinner for his wife and kids when I stopped by later. In which family is the father caring towards his wife?
A. The Syrian family
B. The French family
C. Cannot be determined
